//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the BANDED CONTAINER — the `.pa-banded` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.DataDisplay.banded/1`, svelte `display/Banded.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. The harness renders one component whose slot receives plain TEXT (the dumper HTML-escapes it), so row markup can't flow through the slot; the body area is a bare text token. Per-ROW structure (pa-banded__row / __label / __value / __copy + the copy state modifiers) lives in a SEPARATE sub-component (svelte BandedRow.svelte, keen banded_row/1) fed via the default slot — no dumper wiring exists for that fragment, so it is DEFERRED as acknowledged PROSE (a fixture-ref would DEFER?-fail: there is no banded-row fragment fixture/dumper clause). This fixture proves ONLY what the container itself emits: its <div>, its pa-banded class, the eight layout modifiers, and the class passthrough. The OPTIONAL responsive wrapper pa-banded-container is a sibling structural block (svelte hasContainerQuery / absent in keen) — it is an enclosing wrapper, NOT a pa-banded modifier, so it is out of this container's compare scope and noted in deferred.

propsVocabulary.narrow: boolean — narrow (8rem) label band (pa-banded--narrow). svelte: width='narrow' (enum); keen: is_narrow (bool)
propsVocabulary.wide: boolean — wide (20rem) label band (pa-banded--wide). svelte: width='wide' (enum); keen: is_wide (bool). Mutually exclusive with narrow
propsVocabulary.truncate: boolean — single-line ellipsis on labels + values (pa-banded--truncate)
propsVocabulary.body: the row area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real pa-banded__row children are the deferred sub-component)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only — the banded container adds no attribute conventions (unlike button's type). The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container's tag + class + the layout modifiers, not rich row content. The width band is modeled as two mutually-exclusive bool features (narrow / wide) rather than one enum because the wrappers diverge: svelte exposes a single width='narrow'|'wide' enum (each bool maps to a fixed `const` width value in its map), keen exposes two is_narrow / is_wide bools (each maps straight through). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to the eight pa-banded--* BLOCK modifiers, all produced by a feature below. The four __element classes (pa-banded__row / __label / __value / __copy) and the four row STATE modifiers (__row--copy-btn / --copy-hover / --copy-click / --copied) belong to the banded_row sub-component and are DEFERRED (see deferred block) — none are container markup.

wide.note: svelte width='wide' (const); keen is_wide (bool); mutually exclusive with narrow

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; row structure is the deferred sub-component

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-ROW element + state classes of the pa-banded block — NOT container markup. They are emitted by the SEPARATE banded_row sub-component (svelte BandedRow.svelte, keen banded_row/1) fed through the default slot, which the generic dumper passes as plain escaped TEXT, so they cannot materialize here and there is NO banded-row fragment fixture/dumper clause to fixture-ref (a ref would DEFER?-fail). Acknowledged as prose. __copy + __row--copy-* are the shared copy-to-clipboard affordance: copy-btn/-hover/-click are prop-driven row modifiers on the sub-component; --copied is TOGGLED at runtime by the copy JS (svelte `copied` state) and never SSR-authored.
deferred.pa-banded__row: banded_row sub-component (svelte BandedRow.svelte / keen banded_row/1) — not container markup; slot-fed, no fragment fixture/dumper wiring
deferred.pa-banded__label: banded_row sub-component — the tinted label cell
deferred.pa-banded__copy: banded_row sub-component — copy-to-clipboard button (shared copy affordance)
deferred.pa-banded__row--copy-btn: banded_row copyMode='btn' — copy button always visible; row-level prop modifier
deferred.pa-banded__row--copy-hover: banded_row copyMode='hover' — copy button revealed on row hover
deferred.pa-banded__row--copy-click: banded_row copyMode='click' — value itself clickable to copy
deferred.pa-banded__row--copied: runtime-toggled by copy JS (svelte `copied` state) for the 'Copied!' value ::after feedback — never SSR-authored
deferred.pa-banded-container: optional sibling wrapper (container-query host) that ENCLOSES pa-banded; svelte hasContainerQuery, absent in keen — an outer wrapper, not a pa-banded modifier, so out of this container's compare scope
